main.bio: Strategic technology leader and accomplished software engineer with over seven years of experience in FinTech architecture, systems optimization, and enterprise digital transformation. Recognized for delivering scalable, high-impact engineering solutions and maintaining a strong record of open-source contribution and technical innovation. Expertise spans AI integration, data governance, cybersecurity, and resilient infrastructure design — architecting high-availability transaction platforms, production-grade SDKs, complex systems integrations, and large-scale migrations toward secure, self-hosted, data-sovereign environments.
main.tagline: AI & Digital Transformation leader building scalable FinTech platforms, open-source payment SDKs, and secure enterprise infrastructure across Zambia and beyond.
main.contactmessage: Looking for a technology leader, FinTech architect, or integration specialist? Whether it's digital transformation, mobile money SDKs, or full-stack product development — let's talk.

resume.skillmessage: Core competencies across AI strategy, FinTech & mobile money, full-stack architecture, infrastructure, security engineering, and analytics — with a proven track record of open-source impact and enterprise delivery.

work.title: AI & Digital Transformation Manager
highlights: Leading corporate digital transformation initiatives, redesigning cross-functional operational workflows, data flows, and implementing automated control SOPs.
Spearheading organizational AI tool adoption across research, operations, and finance teams while formalizing data governance and responsible AI risk frameworks.
Designing and deploying internal reporting infrastructure, corporate analytics modules, and interactive metric dashboards to optimize operational visibility.
Enforcing information security posture and business continuity via strict access control systems, continuous monitoring, and structured disaster response models.

work.title: Full Stack Development & Integrations Lead
highlights: Architected and managed high-availability financial transactional software supporting 15,000+ active users with sustained 99.9% application availability.
Engineered 20+ hardened RESTful APIs for loan distribution, repayments, and live account auditing while maintaining strict data alignment standards.
Led advanced payment gateway integrations with primary mobile money providers, introducing multi-stage validation that reduced transaction failure rates by 60%.
Optimized production relational databases (PostgreSQL and MySQL) with complex query tuning for multi-tenant real-time ledger generation.
Integrated infrastructure deployments using Docker pipelines, modernizing continuous delivery and reducing overall release windows by 25%.

work.title: Lead Systems Administrator & Integration Specialist
highlights: Managed baseline server infrastructure, designing proactive telemetry tracking systems that boosted system reliability metrics by 35%.
Deployed automated point-of-sale (POS) and internal inventory tracking programs using synchronized logic flows to eliminate transactional discrepancies.
Oversaw corporate network topology safety rules, establishing tight access constraints on operational financial ledgers.

work.title: Systems Developer & Infrastructure Specialist
highlights: Built and maintained real-time synchronized storage systems via MongoDB and Firebase databases for specialized client applications.
Conducted practical engineering and core systems architecture training, mentoring rising technical cohorts in reliable backend development patterns.

projects.name: OWL Social Media Platform
highlights: Direct the software lifecycle and backend scaling for the African-centered OWL platform, implementing massive version overhauls (v2.1.0 to v3.0.0).
Executed a production migration to Supabase while decoupling reliance on third-party hosts in favor of self-hosted, private VPS bare-metal structures for regional data sovereignty.
Re-engineered the backend feed algorithm, replacing randomized arrays with performance-driven query sets and custom interaction penalties to boost user engagement.

projects.name: Zambian FinTech Ecosystem Utilities
highlights: Authored, maintained, and open-sourced production-grade Node.js SDKs for Airtel Money and MTN MoMo, unifying payment steps for developers across Zambia.
Maintained an elite developer ranking in the region, logging 1,234+ productive development hours and 5,000+ public contributions in a single year cycle.
